sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Cold Ocean, Deep Cold Ocean, Deep Lukewarm Ocean, Deep Ocean, Lukewarm Ocean, Ocean, River, and Warm Ocean.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Dive, Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Octazooka, Origin Pulse, Sludge Wave, Surf, Triple Dive, and Whirlpool: 1.2× stronger.
Spikes and Toxic Spikes: no effect here.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Water-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Speed.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Blizzard, Glaciate, and Subzero Slammer change the field into Icy. The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.
Acid Downpour and Sludge Wave change the field into Murkwater Surface once their uses add up to 2 (Acid Downpour 2 and Sludge Wave 1).
Anchor Shot, Dive, Grav Apple, Gravity, and Triple Dive change the field into Underwater.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin or Water Absorb restores 1/16 of its HP.
This field sweeps away entry hazards.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Special Defense +1 and is wrapped in a veil of water (Aqua Ring).

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
